replies.text:
Check of commonly-missed items:

- Automated abuse reachable by anyone: design says "share a dashboard by link with anyone in the company" and "Shared links never expire" — covered by listed threats 2, 3 and 4 (scraping/flooding of the dashboard query path).
- Privileged screens showing content other people supply: design mentions only "Analysts build dashboards on top of the data warehouse"; no user-supplied content, files or profile fields — design does not have it.
- Privileged actions with no record of who did it: design has the share action — "can share a dashboard by link with anyone in the company" — listed threat 6 only covers attribution of viewer *reads* ("Access to health and salary data is attributed to the analyst, not the viewer"), not accountability for who created/shared the link — not covered.
- Personal/financial pages browsers, proxies or CDNs could store: design states no caching, proxy or CDN behaviour — design does not have it.
- Attacker-controlled text reaching logs, CSV exports, emails or headers: design mentions no exports, emails or logging of supplied text — design does not have it.
- Single-reviewer threats 1, 3, 4 (viewer-editable filters/parameters/URL params) and 2 (bearer-token link): the design text never states filters, parameters or drill-through; those depend on how it might be built. Threat 2 is already covered by listed threats 2 and 5.
